# vpcs

VPCs are private networks that keep a project's instances isolated from other tenants.

## GET /v1/vpcs

Operation `vpc_list`.

`GET /v1/vpcs?tenant=&project=`. Flat VPC list. Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `vpc/in_project/` is keyed by the VPC id; the other modes are `400 UnsupportedSortMode` rather than a silent reorder.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_Vpc](schemas.md#resultspage_for_vpc)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/vpcs

Operation `vpc_create`.

`POST /v1/vpcs?tenant=&project=`. Create a VPC under the named project. `silo=` is rejected at the customer surface; tenant + project are both required selectors. Body is the same `NewVpc` shape the /v1/ create handler accepted.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewVpc](schemas.md#newvpc)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [Vpc](schemas.md#vpc)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/vpcs/{vpc}

Operation `vpc_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/vpcs/{vpc}`. Dependency-gated with `409 Conflict`: subnets, non-main route tables, NAT gateways, and routes in the VPC's main route table must all be deleted first. Nothing cascades.

The main route table itself is removed with the VPC, which is why its routes are gated rather than its existence. NAT gateways matter most: they are indexed by VPC alone and hold an address from a shared pool, so a VPC deleted out from under one leaves it reachable from no listing, including the project-level gate, and the address is stranded permanently.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vpc` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `204`: successful deletion
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## PATCH /v1/vpcs/{vpc}

Operation `vpc_update`.
